widgets_values:
WAN 2.2 -> HDR shot plates (based on official/wan22_t2v_hdr_universal)

High/low-noise WAN 2.2 14B, 1280x704, 81 frames.
SDR to HDR Universal runs the math path for video (Video Frames, adaptive knee, temporal smoothing): RUDRA's learned checkpoints are trained on stills, so multi-frame input skips them by design.

Outputs: EXR 16-bit half sequence (comp/grade plate), HDR10 MP4 (H.265 10-bit PQ) for review, SDR MP4 via ACES 2.0, and a contact sheet PNG.
Viewer: HDR plate vs the SDR decode.
